done_when: With an optional forge.toml setting, the generated workflow has no scheduled full suite and Forge's full-run next step names the repo's own workflow; sign-off and the push guard still accept a forge-full-suite status posted by that workflow; without the setting nothing changes
why: A repo with its own nightly test workflow still runs Forge's nightly full suite every night only to get the forge-full-suite status, so it pays for two nightly runs
